rubric_content.text_property: The agent calls the `bigquery_agent` tool to obtain the data, instead of answering the data question from its own knowledge.

The agent makes at least one `bigquery_agent` call, and the request it passes preserves the user's intent: the ranking direction (worst / highest), the number of locations asked for, the pollutant (PM10) and the time period named in the question. If the agent made no `bigquery_agent` call at all, this property is not fulfilled.
The response reports ten locations for May 2026, ordered from the highest average PM10 concentration to the lowest.
The worst location reported has an average PM10 of approximately 42.46 ug/m3 and is in Scott County, Iowa.
The tenth-ranked location reported has an average PM10 of approximately 20.12 ug/m3 and is in Fresno County, California.
